explain.label: Cash at the start of 01 Nov

options.label: Small mobile-wallet loan
options.anchored_on: City Bank and bKash Digital Nano Loan
options.note: A personal loan to the owner: check you may use it for a business bill. Limit raised to BDT 50,000 and repayment time to six months (June 2025 report); 9% a year, as reported at launch.

options.label: Bank small-business loan, no security needed
options.anchored_on: BRAC Bank small-business loans without security
options.note: A business loan. Special rate 'as low as 13.75%' for August and September 2025. The source doesn't say how long it takes; LaMP assumes 14 days.

options.label: Microfinance business loan
options.note: A business loan. The source says microfinance institutions charge 'upwards of 20 per cent', so 20% is the lowest. You usually need to be a member and repay every week.

options.label: Mobile-wallet Pay Later
options.anchored_on: City Bank and bKash Pay Later
options.ineligible_reason: Your supplier may not accept wallet payments.
options.note: Only for buying from shops that take wallet payments. Free if repaid within 7 days; otherwise it becomes a three-month loan at 9% a year.

options.label: Bank loan from the government small-business fund
options.anchored_on: Bangladesh Bank's Tk 5,000 crore fund for small-business loans
options.ineligible_reason: Takes about 21 days, but you need the money in 16.
to_confirm: a clean credit record with Bangladesh Bank
options.note: A business loan. Banks may charge at most 9% a year. You repay over up to three years and can start 3–6 months later. Anyone with a bad record in Bangladesh Bank's credit check can't get it. The source doesn't say how long it takes; LaMP assumes 21 days for a bank loan.

options.label: Credit from an online wholesale app
options.ineligible_reason: Your supplier may not sell on this app; its price isn't public.
options.note: A business loan. Credit for shops that buy through the app. Its price isn't published, so LaMP can't compare its cost.
